readme: UI Review options (plugin-settings@1): the options its Settings → Plugins → UI Review tab hosts, read and set through server/plugin_options.py. waitForLook holds builds for Brett's look approval, so it is owner-only: no command changes it.

settings.label: Options per build
settings.description: How many options (ui-choices@1) a build ships for every UI it makes. Never below 3.

settings.label: Ask me how many
settings.description: A build asks how many options to make before it makes them; no answer in time keeps the number above.

settings.label: Wait for the look
settings.description: Builds that change the UI wait for Brett's OK on the predicted look before they go on. Owner-only.
